visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and glasses, wearing a black Godzilla graphic t-shirt, stands outdoors in a bright courtyard area talking directly to the camera. (2) The scene cuts to the man indoors in a modern white kitchen, now wearing a beige t-shirt, gesturing expressively as he speaks. (3) He displays a large, grey frozen fish head to the lens before placing it into a stainless steel bowl. (4) Close-up shot shows his hands putting the fish head into an air fryer basket. (5) He uses a large kitchen knife to cut a block of soft white tofu into cubes on a wooden board. (6) In a white ceramic pot, he combines water, scallions, ginger, and dried chilies on a black stovetop. (7) He adds soy sauce and a spice packet to the simmering liquid. (8) He uses tongs to place the fried fish heads into the boiling pot. (9) He adds dried bay leaves and a bowl of peppercorns. (10) He adds tofu and green 'wawa' cabbage to the mixture. (11) He covers the pot with a white lid, then removes it to show the bubbling soup. (12) He garnishes the dish with chopped scallions, pepper, and sesame seeds. (13) Sitting at a wooden table, he drinks from a glass and begins eating the fish with chopsticks. (14) Several extreme close-ups feature him eating chunks of fish, cabbage, and tofu with steam rising. (15) He returns to the outdoor setting in the black t-shirt, giving a thumbs up while speaking to the camera. (16) A simple cartoon animation of a boy and girl appears on a yellow background.
